question: Who among the following is one of the founder members of Bhartiya Jana Sangh?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Shyama Prasad Mukherjee**__.

__
 
• **Shyama Prasad Mukherjee** is one of the founder members of **Bhartiya Jana Sangh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Bharatiya Jana Sangh** was an** Indian right-wing political party** that existed from** 1951 to 1977.**
 
• In **1977, Bharatiya Jana Sangh** merged with several other left, centre and right parties opposed to the **Indian National Congress **and formed the** Janata Party.**
 
• In **1980**, the** Jana Sangh** faction broke away from** Janata Party** over the issue of **dual membership** and formed **Bharatiya Janata Party.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Person Name**
 **Details**
 
 

 **KM Munshi**
 
 
 
• He was born on 30 December 1887, Bharuch.
 
• KM Munshi, was an Indian independence movement activist, politician, writer and educationist from Gujarat state.
 
 
 
 

 **Baldev Singh**
 
 
 
• He was born on 11 July 1902, in Rupnagar.
 
• Baldev Singh was an Indian Sikh political leader, he was an Indian independence movement leader and the first Defence Minister of India.
 
• Baldev Singh was chosen to become the first Minister of Defence.
 
 
 
 

 **Minoo** **Masani**
 
 
 
• He was born on 20 November 1905, Mumbai.
 
• Minoo Masani was an Indian politician, a leading figure of the erstwhile Swatantra Party.
 
• He was a three-time Member of Parliament, representing Gujarat's Rajkot constituency in the second, third and fourth Lok Sabha.
 
 
 
 

 **Shyama Prasad Mukherjee**
 
 
 
• He was born on 6 July 1901, Kolkata.
 
• Syama Prasad Mukherjee was an Indian politician, barrister, and academician, who served as the Minister for Industry and Supply in Jawaharlal Nehru's cabinet.
 
• He was also the president of Akhil Bharatiya Hindu Mahasabha from 1943 to 1946.
